name: Kokerlii
summary: A small, squat humanoid alien from the planet UTol who becomes one of Nomad's traveling companions on Canticle. Kokerlii is chatty, optimistic, and provides much-needed comic relief in the grim setting of the sun-scorched world. Despite his small size and apparent weakness, Kokerlii possesses a surprisingly sharp mind and an unbreakable spirit. He serves as a moral compass for Nomad, reminding him of the value of hope and friendship even in the most desperate circumstances.
